name: Red Earth — Gate 2 Starter First-Presentation Fix
author: Adam M. Aguilera
description: Gate 2.7 timing-only repair: intended Oak gift starters are shiny at creation, Oak's acceptance/Dex preview uses their shiny front art, and their first player send-out receives the accepted gold/lilac shiny sparkle and sound. No scaling, evolution, starter-selection, Nature, passive, or Irregular-art changes.
